summary: User seeks release timeline information for a custom archiver server option feature merged in PR #9090 that appears in pre-release versions but not yet in official releases. Asks about target version, ETA, and production-readiness of pre-release versions.
userImpact: Users need clarity on when the custom archiver feature will be officially available and whether pre-release versions are safe for production use.
workaround: Use pre-release versions such as v1.31.0-154.2 that already contain the feature.
resolutionDetails: Question addressed in comment: v1.31 release is planned for the following week, confirming feature will be in the next official minor release.
keyQuote: Next minor release v1.31 is planned to be published next week.
